$comment: Facts about the HUB building-register feed, not about region code changes (root ADR-0142, ADR-0145 §3). The hub exports read them through services/foundation-outbox-publisher/src/sigungu_crosswalk.rs. Moved here from the hand-kept 27-pair crosswalk file, which is now only a test fixture and a temporary comparison baseline.

placeholder_sigungu.$comment: Codes the HUB register feed writes where a row has no real 시군구 (ADR-0142). They name no parcel, so composition yields a NULL pnu for them instead of an orphan PNU, and every export counts them in its summary. Measured by scanning the 2026-09 title and unit Bronze for 시군구 codes outside the cadastral parcel set's 시도.

absent_sido_row_bound.$comment: An export refuses when the rows of one 시도 prefix that is neither in the cadastral parcel set (vworld-parcel-source-objects.json) nor governed above exceed this bound (ADR-0142). Such rows compose PNUs no parcel carries, which no NULL-share check sees. The 2026-09 Bronze held one stray row of that kind; the smallest real 시도 has 39,178 title rows and the 2026-07 merged 시도 brought 928,891.
